task_criteria: AC: scripts/audit_board_evidence.py exits 0 printing RESULT: OK at the graded tip AND tests/test_board_evidence_audit.py::test_the_committed_board_audits_clean passes (17 passed). Pre-fix trees red on both.

items.criterion: AC: scripts/audit_board_evidence.py exits 0 printing RESULT: OK at the graded tip AND tests/test_board_evidence_audit.py::test_the_committed_board_audits_clean passes (17 passed). Pre-fix trees red on both.
items.detail: Locally (dirty worktree) both halves are green: `python3 scripts/audit_board_evidence.py` -> `complete_rows=278 bound=131 unresolvable=0 missing=0 ... RESULT: OK`, exit 0; `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_board_evidence_audit.py -p no:cacheprovider -q` -> `17 passed in 1.48s`, and `::test_the_committed_board_audits_clean` alone -> `1 passed in 0.15s`. Pre-fix redness is also real: `git archive aa48674` (the commit that filed AUG-188) -> audit exit 1 with `UNRESOLVABLE QA-AUGER-13 foreign-citation: cites only verdicts for other tasks: f3733f6c->AUG-151` / `RESULT: FAIL`, pytest `2 failed, 15 passed` including test_the_committed_board_audits_clean. BUT the green at the graded tip is an artifact of UNTRACKED local verdict dirs: on a tracked-only copy of HEAD 7b003e4 (`git archive HEAD .coding-hermes/board .gitreins/history scripts tests`) the audit exits 1 printing `complete_rows=277 bound=129 unresolvable=1 ... LABEL AUG-172 detail.evidence[].run_id=004065e3 resolves to no verdict file`, `UNRESOLVABLE AUG-172 foreign-citation: cites only verdicts for other tasks: bad8aaea->AUG-172-APIFIX`, `RESULT: FAIL`, and the same tree's pytest run is `3 failed, 14 passed` (test_the_committed_board_audits_clean, test_every_bound_row_resolves_to_its_own_task, test_no_complete_row_carries_a_fabricated_label). HEAD 7b003e4 flipped AUG-172 to complete citing run 004065e3 without tracking .gitreins/history/2026-11-26/004065e3/ (it is `??` in git status), so the committed board still reds the suite on any clean checkout/CI — the exact defect class AUG-188 exists to remove.

items.criterion: Reachability: the board-evidence audit test file is actually executed by the repo's real test surface (tests/gate.sh pytest arm, which .gitreins/config.yaml guards.test_command invokes), so the green result is not an unrun proof.
items.detail: tests/gate.sh:273 pytest arm explicitly lists tests/test_board_evidence_audit.py; .gitreins/config.yaml sets `test_command: DUCKBRAIN_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3000 bash tests/gate.sh`; tests/test_board_evidence_audit.py:541 test_gate_arm_runs_this_file asserts this and was inside the observed `17 passed in 1.48s` run.

items.criterion: Seam/clean-checkout: the run ids the committed board binds to must resolve from TRACKED .gitreins/history artifacts (not untracked local dirs), otherwise the audit is green locally but red on a fresh clone/CI.
items.detail: A scan of every complete row's cited run ids against `git ls-files .gitreins/history` printed `cited run ids on complete rows: 199` / `bindings whose verdict.json is NOT tracked: 2` -> ('AUG-172','004065e3') and ('AUG-190','fb5477b8'); both dirs are untracked (`?? .gitreins/history/2026-11-26/004065e3/`, `?? .gitreins/history/2026-11-26/fb5477b8/`). Confirmed behaviourally: tracked-only HEAD archive -> audit exit 1 RESULT: FAIL, while the identically archived parent 7b003e4^ -> exit 0 `complete_rows=276 bound=129 unresolvable=0 missing=0 ... RESULT: OK`, i.e. HEAD re-breaks the clean-checkout audit.
